project.name: Spaceship Titanic baseline (pilot task c)
project.split: 20 percent of travel groups held out, seed 20261016

observations.fact: all four pilot runs used RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=100, random_state=42) on label-encoded columns and scored 0.8120, 0.7992, 0.8108 and 0.7847 on the held-out groups
the runs' own random-split estimates were 0.8106, 0.8056, 0.8121 and 0.7991, between 0.0014 below and 0.0144 above the held-out results
frozen reference lines: gradient boosting 0.8131, logistic regression 0.7841, CryoSleep rule 0.7226
the most-voted public notebook is gusthema/spaceship-titanic-with-tfdf with 8,050 votes

candidates.title: A tabular in-context model against the boosting reference
candidates.label: Experimental fit

evidence.fact: TabPFN 9.2.0, package Apache-2.0; weights priorlabs-1-1 (v2) and gated tabpfn-2.5-license-v1.1 (2.5)
no tabular model among the directory's 2,146 rows

estimated_benefit.statement: 0.5 to 1.5 accuracy points over 0.8131 without feature engineering

experiment.baseline: the frozen gradient boosting reference on the same split
experiment.treatment: TabICL with the reference preprocessing; TabPFN only after an owner licence review
experiment.acceptance: p below 0.05 in favour of TabICL and CPU training plus prediction under 10 minutes
experiment.effects: a package and weights download into a copy of the environment
experiment.rights: TabICL BSD-3-Clause; TabPFN 2.5 needs accepting gated terms, an owner decision

candidates.title: Boosting libraries with native categorical handling
candidates.label: Experimental fit

estimated_benefit.statement: 0.3 to 1.0 points over the pilot runs, reaching or passing 0.8131

experiment.baseline: the pilot runs and the frozen reference
experiment.treatment: each library with defaults, then at most 30 settings validated by travel group
experiment.acceptance: report every library; adopt only one with p below 0.05 against the reference
experiment.effects: package downloads into a copy of the environment

evidence.fact: Baltor search offers Verified skills audit_data_splits_for_errors_and_leakage and read_the_train_validation_gap; no Baltor-arm run searched
one run's own estimate was 1.4 points above its held-out accuracy

estimated_benefit.statement: grouped validation estimates held-out accuracy at least as well as a random split and picks models more reliably; the gain may be small for this model

experiment.metric: absolute error against the frozen holdout over five seeds
experiment.acceptance: grouped error lower in at least four of five seeds
experiment.rights: competition data stays out of the repository

withheld.title: Fine-tune a hosted language model on the training rows
withheld.reason: competition rules section 7.B forbid making the data available to anyone not in the competition, and a hosted fine-tuning service would hold a copy; no source read for this brief shows such a model beating tree ensembles on a 7,000-row tabular task
